note: Vocal-chain presets, checkpoint rule: every version is its own file, never overwritten. Rebuild a version from its preset + the named lead file + the named build script.

v11.lead: vocal-autotune-v2.wav (pitch x2.0, formant x1.4, D major, glide 55ms)

v12.lead: vocal-autotune-v3.wav (pitch x2.41, formant x1.4, D major, glide 55ms)

v13.lead: vocal-autotune-v3.wav (pitch x2.41, formant x1.4, D major, glide 55ms)
v13.delay: dotted-eighth 321.4ms + 642ms tap, wet 0.25, chorus (dreamy, tempo-synced at 140 BPM)
v13.god_particle_style_bus: EQ + compressor 0.15/3:1/10ms/120ms/makeup 4dB + saturation bits=12 mix=0.3 + limiter 0.89, Amount equivalent 100% (Jaycen default)

v14.lead: vocal-autotune-v4.wav (pitch x2.58, formant x1.4, D major, glide 55ms)
v14.limiter: alimiter 0.89, light bus comp 0.20/2:1 makeup 2dB, NO bus crusher
v14.overdub: low autotune-v2 (290Hz) + Pancake-style auto-pan 0.4Hz LFO + heavenly chorus (chorus 0.5/25|35ms), vol 0.35

v15.lead: vocal-autotune-v5.wav (pitch x2.73, formant x1.4, D major, glide 55ms)
v15.ott_style: parallel heavily-compressed copy (0.05/10:1, makeup 3dB) mixed at 0.15 depth — Xfer OTT lead-vocal depth 7-20%, 15% typical, de-esser after (kept)
v15.octave_up_layer: rubberband pitch 2.0 on warped-norm phrases, vol 0.25
v15.overdub: low autotune-v2 (290Hz) + Pancake auto-pan 0.4Hz + heavenly chorus, vol 0.35
v15.tail_cut: vocal bus fade-out at 39.81s (last phrase end), 0.5s — delay ring 39.8-40.3s RMS 0.190 -> 0.145, title loop untouched

god_particle_research.method: mix INTO it from the start, hit input targets (green brackets)
god_particle_research.our_build: open-source ffmpeg equivalent of those functions, NOT the paid plugin itself

reverse_engineer_tool: reverse_engineer.py — given any reference song, measures RMS/peak/crest, band power, vocal pitch median, stereo width, and outputs a suggested preset JSON in presets/reverse-<label>.json

neptune_deep_reverse.conclusion: vocal lives F4-G4 (349-392Hz), AVANNA top G4; v14 lead 368Hz sits inside it; outro section is vocal-forward (vocalband 0.229 vs 0.05 elsewhere)

genre_research.genre: hyperpop, specifically digicore — loosely-defined exaggerated pop drawing on electronic, hip hop, dance; NTS digicore guide lists Deko PHANTASY STAR ONLINE ft Yameii alongside Jane Remover, 100 gecs, Glaive, ericdoa, midwxst, SEBii
genre_research.yameii: virtual musician/digital rapper conceived by Osean + Deko, Vocaloid-based (AVANNA), anime/metaverse presentation
genre_research.rulebook_break: AVANNA recommended top is G4 (392Hz) but neptune outro hits 394Hz median and D5 per-second notes — v15 lead median 394Hz deliberately sits at/above that ceiling, matching the reference, not the spec sheet

free_plugins_researched.OTT (Xfer, free): multiband upward/downward compression; lead vocal depth 7-20%, 15% typical, de-esser after — our open-source equivalent wired in v15
free_plugins_researched.Valhalla Supermassive (free): huge evolving delay/reverb, 18 modes — dreamy space; our equivalent is the 321ms tempo delay + chorus + echo taps
free_plugins_researched.Graillon 3 Free / MAutoPitch (free): pitch correction + formant shift — our equivalent is the pyworld autotune/formant scripts
free_plugins_researched.TDR Nova (free): dynamic EQ — our equivalent is the dual-EQ chain (EQ1 vocal, EQ2 bus)
free_plugins_researched.Vital / Surge XT (free, open): synths for future game tracks, not used on this vocal mix
free_plugins_researched.note: VST binaries themselves are NOT redistributed in the public repo (licences); their FUNCTIONS are built open-source in ffmpeg/python and documented in tools/music-production/free-plugins-and-genre-research.md
